**COLORED JONES POLYNOMIALS WITHOUT TAILS**

*CHRISTINE RUEY SHAN LEE AND ROLAND VAN DER VEEN*

5 pp, 7 sections.

**Abstract.** We exhibit an in nite family of knots with the property that the rst coecient of the n-colored Jones polynomial grows linearly with n. This shows that the concept of stability and tail seen in the colored Jones polynomials of alternating knots does not generalize naively.

**Outline.** 2 Colored Jones polynomial; 1 Introduction; 2 C. LEE AND R. V AN DER VEEN; 2 Ok = (−1)k[k + 1] = (−1)kv2k +lot; 4 C. LEE AND R. V AN DER VEEN; 3 The lack of tail; References
